Machine Learning
ES 654 · IIT Gandhinagar · Semester II, 2021–22
ES 654 introduces machine learning: metrics, decision trees and ensembles, linear regression with gradient descent, ridge and lasso, Bayesian learning and logistic regression, neural networks and CNNs, naive Bayes, support vector machines and unsupervised learning. Every lecture links its slides, and most link a class recording.

  InstructorProf. Nipun Batra
  Emailnipun.batra@iitgn.ac.in
  ClassesMonday 10:05–11:00 am, Wednesday 9:05–10:00 am, Thursday 10:05–11:00 am
  OnlineZoom link
  Google ClassroomCode jclv62l
  Teaching assistants4 TAs
  PrerequisitesGood experience in Python programming, probability and linear algebra



Course record
This offering ran from January to April 2022. Its slides, class recordings and quiz papers remain available.

Questions
Where are the grading policy and the course FAQ?In the course FAQ and grading policy document. You have comment access: comment on it to ask for more details.
Where can I find project ideas?In the list of project ideas. You have comment access: comment on it to ask the TAs for more details.
What are the prerequisites?Good experience in Python programming, probability and linear algebra.
How do I prepare before the course?Refresh the prerequisites with the first four chapters of the Python Data Science Handbook, some material on linear algebra and Khan Academy's course on statistics and probability.
Where are the class recordings?Each lecture on the Lectures page links its recording where one exists, and all of them are in a Google Drive folder. Spreadsheets used in class are in another folder.

References
Reference textbooks:

  Gareth James, Daniela Witten, Trevor Hastie and Robert Tibshirani, An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Applications in R (online)
  Christopher M. Bishop, Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning, Springer, 2006 (free PDF)
  Jerome Friedman, Trevor Hastie and Robert Tibshirani, The Elements of Statistical Learning, Springer, 2001 (free PDF)
  Richard O. Duda, Peter E. Hart and David G. Stork, Pattern Classification, John Wiley & Sons, 2012
  Tom M. Mitchell, Machine Learning, McGraw Hill, 1997
  Kevin P. Murphy, Machine Learning: A Probabilistic Perspective, MIT Press
  Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio and Aaron Courville, Deep Learning, MIT Press, 2016 (online)

Other machine learning courses:

  NPTEL course by Balaraman Ravindran
  CMU course by Tom Mitchell and Maria-Florina Balcan
  Coursera course by Andrew Ng
  fast.ai course on ML and Practical deep learning for coders
  Course by Alex Ihler, UCI
